newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mitrajaya plans bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Mitrajaya plans bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Malaysia's Mitrajaya Holdings Bhd has proposed a two-for-five bonus issue of 7.61 million new shares and a one-for-two rights issue of 9.51 million shares at 6.20 ringgit per share.

A statement released by the civil engineering and construction firm on Wednesday said it also planned an issue of 60 million ringgit zero to four percent redeemable bank guaranteed bonds. The five-year bonds will be issued together with 17.12 million detachable warrants.
The warrants will be offered to Mitrajaya shareholders at a price to be determined later on the basis of nine warrants for every 10 existing shares held before the proposed bonus and rights issues.
The company has also proposed an employees' share option scheme not exceeding 10 percent of its paid-up capital, the statement said.

Proceeds from the rights and bond issues totalling 119.45 million ringgit would be used to acquire a building, purchase of plant and machinery, repay bank borrowings and as working capital for projects, it said.

Mitrajaya's paid-up capital will increase to 56.88 million ringgit from the present 19.02 million after the bonus and rights issues and upon full exercise of warrants and options arising from the employees' share option scheme. The group's net tangible assets per share will increase to 4.80 ringgit from 1.78 ringgit, the statement said.
Mitrajaya shares closed at 15.00 ringgit on Wednesday.
